units.source_text: 大寺院的内部好相当宽敞。

en.t: The interior of the great temple was quite spacious.

units.source_text: 科林斯式风格的圆柱建筑之间有几个朝拜者穿行而过。

en.t: Several worshippers passed between the Corinthian-style columns.

units.source_text: 他们和我们一般，显得十分渺小。

en.t: They, like us, looked extremely small.

units.source_text: 后来我们还遇见一只弯腰驼背的老河童。

en.t: Later, we also encountered an old, bent-backed kappa.
